content.title: 2026 Masters Thursday TV coverage: How to watch Round 1 at Augusta National
content.text: Rory McIlroy will get his title defense at the 2026 Masters started early on Thursday at Augusta National. Thomas Lovelock/Augusta National/Getty Images You’re reading our viewer’s guide for Round 1. For complete TV coverage and streaming schedules for Friday’s second round of the 2026 Masters, click here.———The 2026 Masters finally gets underway Thursday morning, April 9, with the first round at Augusta National. Here’s everything you need to know to watch the tournament on Thursday, including full Masters TV coverage, streaming info and Round 1 tee times.How to watch Masters on ThursdayOn Thursday morning, major season begins at Augusta National with the opening round of the 2026 Masters.Heading into the this year’s event, one big question on fans’ minds involves last year’s Masters champion, Rory McIlroy. Can McIlroy defend his title and capture his second green jacket this week?MASTERS LIVE UPDATES: Follow Round 1 action at Augusta NationalHe’ll have lots of competition, including from his own grouping for Round 1. Playing partner Cameron Young is fresh off a recent win at the 2026 Players Championship, the biggest of his career. Rory McIlroy is relaxed at this Masters. That makes him dangerous By: Michael Bamberger Meanwhile, LIV stars Bryson DeChambeau and 2023 winner Jon Rahm are hoping to bring home a Masters victory themselves. And let’s not forget about other past champions expected to contend this year, such as World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler and Jordan Spieth.You can watch the first round of the Masters on TV via ESPN, which will air coverage beginning on Thursday at 3 p.m. ET. Masters.com, the Masters app, Amazon Prime Video, Paramount+ and the ESPN App will provide exhaustive streaming coverage starting at 7:30 a.m. ET with the honorary starters.Below you will find everything you need to know to watch the first round of the 2026 Masters.How to watch on TV ThursdayESPN will provide first-round TV coverage of the 2026 Masters from 3-7:30 p.m. ET on Thursday.How to stream online ThursdayYou can stream the first round of the 2026 Masters via Masters.com, the Masters app, the ESPN App, Amazon Prime Video, Paramount+ and DirecTV, with several streaming options available.
